environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No reverse proxy or API gateway in front. The app_config.signing_client is a local SoftHSM2 PKCS#11 instance used only for the /csrf-token endpoint's token generation. The /transfer endpoint has NO server-side CSRF validation - the comment about 'infrastructure request signing verification layer' is aspirational documentation from a design doc that was never implemented. SameSite cookie attribute defaults to 'Lax' in modern browsers but the endpoint accepts POST with Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded which is exempt from SameSite=Lax protections for top-level navigations.

config.signing_backend: SoftHSM2 local PKCS#11, used only for /csrf-token response generation
config.cookie_settings: httponly=True, samesite not explicitly set (defaults vary)
